name: OG Keepers

roster._note: IL slots are not drafted. Last season's draft was exactly 154 picks = 14 teams x 11, confirming 11 drafted spots.

keepers._note: Yahoo's draft room is authoritative (decided 2026-10-09): it enforces budgets and blocks nominating kept players. Its Draft Results page disagreed with the league sheet on 3 teams (amens +Tatum $25, bbspartan +Reaves $29, theogog no Durant). Re-sync by saving the page and running scripts/yahoo_sync.py. source_of_truth='league_sheet' restores data/keepers.csv. Escalator is +$6/yr.

tuning._availability_note: waiver_fill (chosen 2026-10-09): season = GP*per_game + (82-GP)*waiver_line, the per-game line of per-game ranks 133-156. 2 IL slots + 88 adds means missed games are streamed. availability_blend only applies when availability_model='blend' (0.5 there reproduces the 4f2613f board exactly).
tuning._depth_note: 132 rostered of 234 projected players. Shallow pool: replacement level is high, stars are relatively more valuable, punting is less forced than in a 14-team league.
tuning._playoff_note: 8 of 12 teams make playoffs (67%), so prefer ceiling over floor.

_budget_note: Not flat $200: each team is $200 + bracket-challenge winnings. Verified identical between the league sheet (starting+winnings) and Yahoo's draft budget table. Team names differ between the two sources, so aliases are explicit rather than fuzzy-matched.
